reviews.comment: Professor Jennifer gives the best feedback on writing. If you want a good grade, incorporate her feedback! She is the most kind professor you will meet at A&M. Do not be shy to ask questions in her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is one of my favorite professors at A&M! She is clear with expectations, very knowledgable in her field, is there to help you, is very professional, and understands that we have several other courses, so she does not overwhelm with workload. I thought this class was very manageable and interesting, and she did a wonderful job facilitating it.

Cannot recommend Professor Lueck enough! The best COMM professor I've had at A&M. She is so kind and helps you throughout the entire course with your essays. 10/10 recommend taking her class if you can
This class was pretty easy. What sucks about it is that if you miss one single assignment it will change your grade drastically and she is not flexible. No extra credit.

She is an amazing professor who really cares about her students. There will be feedback for your writing assignments so that helps and she is always available through email. I highly recommend taking a class with her, she's a hidden gem in the COMM department!

One of the nicest profs ever. I recommend watching the lectures & participating bc that's how you'll get the most info out of the class, but she posts all her slides so if you miss a few it's not a huge deal. Almost all the info she talks about is in her slides. There's 1 paper, 14 weekly quizzes, & a final. Not a hard class to get an A in.

It is so clear that professor Lueck loves what she teaches. She was kind, patient, and interactive with us in the online environment which helped the lack of in person lectures. Having 24 hour grace periods on quizzes was a huge help, and she related to the students well. 10/10 recommend!!

Not a bad professor but being in the online format I feel made this class much tougher than it usually is. quizzes all semester wasn't too bad but the final exam was the hardest I took all semester. Feel like I would of enjoyed this class if it was not online.

She is a big talker but I loved listening to her. The textbook was helpful and she has it linked on Canvas so there is no need to purchase it. Overall, she was a great professor and I learned some interesting persuasive strategies from her class.

Prof Lueck is so educated in what she is teaching. She is thorough, efficient, & her content is interesting & applicable. Weekly quizzes are timed but open note. She also gives a 24 hr grace period if u miss a due date. Love her calm, engaging teaching style & think she is a well organized, captivating prof that everyone should take!

No tests; just 2 big papers that are about 4 pages long each & a pitch at the end of the semester. She posted her lecture slides don't explain ANYTHING so you have to go to class to sort of understand them. She is a super easy grader though with the papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: just three tests all online, lectures are good but she doesn't post them to ecampus so i spent the semester taking pics of every slide because I couldn't write fast enough. Lueck is nice and her tests are closely related to lectures, didn't have to read and still got an A. only one small project and it was easy, attend COMM day for extra credit!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fantastic prof. Scary on the first day but don't be intimidated. Sit in the front, she will connect with you better. Interactive lecture style. Very understanding and WILL work with you when you're struggling. EXTRA CREDIT, do it! Tests were easy for some, tough for others but GO TO lectures, she DOESN'T post lectures or notes online.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I absolutely adored Prof Lueck! She cares so much about her students and the material. She made me love going to her 8 am lectures and its 100% because of the way she teaches. Her exams are hard because they are application based but if you study and go to lecture, you should be fine. But she DOES NOT post her lectures so going to class is a must.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Lueck gave really interesting lectures and the class ACTUALLY participated. She is really sweet and willing to help you succeed, although there was only two tests, a final, and a group paper - and they are all weighed equally - so you had to do well on all to get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Lueck is an amazing professor. There isn't a lot of feedback for her yet because she is new to A&M but do yourself a favor and take her! She is really kind, cares about her students, and will go the extra mile to help you succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring
